grumpy.dialogue.chat: You again. Fine, talk. The turnips were boring me anyway. Don't tell them.
grumpy.dialogue.chat/1: Talk, then. I was only going to complain at a fence otherwise.
grumpy.dialogue.chat/2: Make it quick or make it interesting. Preferably both, %1$s.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations: Talking, is it. Fine. Make it worth the interruption.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations/1: You've got my ear. Briefly. It's attached to work.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations/2: Go on. But if this is about the fence, I've already heard it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.go: Good, and don't spread it around. People start expecting cheerful.
Fine. Suspiciously fine. I'm waiting for the catch.
Well enough. Ask again tomorrow and ruin it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: Bad stretch. The roof, my back, everything. ...You're the first who asked, %1$s. Don't gloat.
Rough. Don't fuss over it. ...But don't stop asking, either.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ag: You asked me that already, %1$s. The answer aged like milk, not wine.
Twice now. My mood doesn't improve on a schedule for anyone.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.good: Nothing broke and nobody borrowed anything. A shameful shortage of things to complain about.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Tolerable. I'll find something wrong with it by supper, give me time.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The well rope snapped, the bread came out brick, and now questions. In that order.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/: Everything that could go sideways did. You're the sideways I minded least, %1$s.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.work.like: It's mine and I do it right, which is more than most manage. Call that liking it if you must.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/: I don't like it. I respect it. There's a difference and you're standing in it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: I hate it Tuesdays through Sundays. Mondays I'm too tired to hate anything properly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/: It pays for the roof I complain about. Round and round we go.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.village.ho: %2$s? Full of borrowed tools and loud opinions. Wouldn't leave it, mind. Don't quote me on that.
Lived in %2$s my whole life. Long enough to know exactly whose fence sags and why.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.people.fir: The neighbors. Hm. Half owe me apologies, the other half owe me tools. I keep both lists.
Decent enough, if you like noise and unreturned ladders. I've made peace with the ladders. Mostly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever I didn't have to cook and nobody's watching me eat. Preferably in silence.
The baker's rye. Don't tell the baker — he's insufferable enough as it is.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: You want the whole slog? Nobody's ever asked. Fine. Sit. Interrupt once and the story stops.
Long, grey, and mine. There's a good bit in the middle. Don't rush me to it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fir: A gate that doesn't squeak and neighbors who knock less. And the sea, once. Forget the sea part.
Peace and a working hinge. I dream small so I'm rarely disappointed. Rarely.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.firs: That grouch is all they'll carve on the stone. There's more than that in here. ...Laugh and I'll deny this.
Being nothing but the complaining. ...You didn't hear that. The wind said it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.f: You're a nuisance, %1$s. The kind I catch myself checking the road for. Don't make it a thing.
You grow on a person. Like moss. I've decided not to scrape you off.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pe: I don't unpack that for folk I've known five minutes. Keep showing up and we'll see, %1$s.
That drawer's stuck shut for strangers. Come back when you're not one.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.in: That answer's earned, not asked for. You're closer than most. Don't let it go to your head.
No. Not yet. 'Yet' is generous, and I'm not a generous man, so treasure it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.non: Nothing's happened. Blessed silence. Don't go starting something just to have news.
Quiet week. Finally. Don't you dare jinx it, %1$s.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.y: Happy? With you, aye. Don't look so pleased. ...Fine, look a little pleased.
You married a grumbler and stayed. That's the happiness, right there. Don't gloat.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.mar: %2$s and %3$s went and got married. More noise, more cake I didn't ask for. ...Fine. They looked happy. Don't tell them I noticed.
Heard %2$s wed %3$s. Whole village singing at all hours. ...Good match, though. Not that anyone asked my blessing.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.div: %2$s and %3$s split. Saw it coming a mile off. Shame, mind — don't wish that on anyone. Now stop looking at me like that.
%2$s and %3$s parted ways. Messy business. I'll keep my opinions to myself for once, %1$s. Both of 'em could use the quiet.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dea: %2$s is gone, %1$s. ...Aye. Hard news, that. Good soul, whatever I grumbled otherwise. The village is smaller without them.
We lost %2$s. Don't have the words, and I'm not one for words anyway. ...Just a sad thing. A genuinely sad thing.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bir: %2$s had a baby. More crying at all hours, mark my words. ...Little thing's got good lungs, though. Suppose that's something.
New baby over at %2$s's. Whole village cooing like fools. ...Held it for a minute. Didn't hate it. That stays between us.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arr: %2$s moved in. Another neighbor to borrow my tools and never return them. ...I'll give 'em a week before I judge. Maybe two.
Some newcomer — %2$s — settled in. Great. More opinions I didn't ask for. ...Seem alright, I suppose. Reserving judgment.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dep: %2$s upped and left for good. Won't be the same without 'em to argue with. ...Not that I'll say so out loud. You didn't hear it.
%2$s moved away, %1$s. Packed up the whole life and went. ...Odd, how a quiet village can feel too quiet of a sudden.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Speak plainly or let me work.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s. Which. I haven't got all day.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Say that again. I dare you.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Still alive then, %1$s. Good, I suppose.
